conventions.decision: AI full-text eligibility recommendation, distinct from final human/formal inclusion.
conventions.read_extent: Eligibility requires sufficient full-text evidence for every criterion, not independent verification of every proof, appendix or codebase. Inspected extent and version are specified per record.
conventions.features: Only feature_codes fields are verified in this checkpoint. Other legacy feature codes remain provisional. No means not demonstrated in the inspected evidence/version; Partial requires the stated limitation.
conventions.uq: Image UQ includes deterministic sets and posterior variability; it does not imply calibrated probabilities. Operator UQ requires uncertainty for operator parameters, not image variance caused by uncertain physics.
conventions.access: Four complete PDFs retrieved and inspected for eligibility. Six remaining records have access notes but no new decisions. Source hashes record provenance; paper content is not redistributed.
conventions.c1: The unchanged 2020–2026 window applies. Official proceedings or explicitly identified preprint/journal versions are inspected; final-version equivalence is not assumed.
conventions.c5: Every assessed record had an accessible English full text at source_url.
conventions.provenance: No reproducible database search or undocumented discovery date is inferred from this targeted batch.
conventions.categorical_operator_uncertainty: P073 O/Q=Partial denotes degradation-class probabilities, not a posterior over physical parameters; R=No. X=Partial denotes predicted-clean stopping, not uncertainty-based rejection or a risk guarantee. P073 W=Partial denotes structural-fidelity comparisons, not measurement-support certification.

records.title: Robust Lensless Image Reconstruction via PSF Estimation
records.read_extent: Main text §§1–6, PDF pp. 1–8; supplementary files and code not audited.
records.technical: Two generators estimate images and PSFs with a forward-consistency loss. Calibration targets are required during training. Multi-PSF and captured-camera tests do not establish held-out-PSF transfer; unseen-noise sensitivity is tested. Point PSFs supply no operator uncertainty.
records.applicability: S denotes unseen-noise testing; U denotes blur plus noise. Video capture does not establish changing-operator inference.
quality_followups: Check held-out PSF identities before claiming cross-device generalization.

3.evidence: Joint PSF/image inference and added-noise robustness.

4.evidence: Operational method/benchmark evaluated in the inspected sections.

5.evidence: Accessible English full paper; local PDF verified.

records.title: LEDNet: Joint Low-light Enhancement and Deblurring in the Dark
records.version: arXiv 2202.03373 v2, 30 August 2022; final proceedings not reconciled.
records.read_extent: Main text §§1–6, pp. 1–14; supplement §§A–C and §D description, pp. 18–22; p. 27 captions. Separate video not inspected.
records.technical: The simulator combines low light, saturation-sensitive motion blur, defocus and noise. The encoder/decoder uses adaptive feature transformations rather than an inferred physical operator. Synthetic paired tests and unpaired real-night evaluations address compound restoration, without probability calibration.
records.applicability: Real-night scores assess perceptual quality without clean reference targets.
quality_followups: Separate enhancement preference from faithful detail recovery; verify final proceedings before numerical reuse.

1.evidence: arXiv 2202.03373 v2, 30 August 2022; final proceedings not reconciled.

records.title: Real-world Video Super-resolution: A Benchmark Dataset and a Decomposition Based Learning Scheme
records.read_extent: Main text §§1–6, PDF pp. 1–8; supplement and code not audited.
records.technical: RealVSR captures paired phone-camera videos and uses decomposed losses to tolerate residual alignment and luminance differences. Cross-phone tests address transfer. Capture includes multiple degradation sources, but no controlled time-varying-operator experiment or uncertainty distribution is demonstrated.
records.applicability: U denotes compound captured acquisition; S includes cross-phone qualitative tests.
quality_followups: Account for excluded severe cases, paired-camera misalignment and generated textures before treating references as exact truth.

3.evidence: Real acquisition mismatch and cross-camera restoration tests.

4.evidence: Operational method/benchmark evaluated in the inspected sections.

5.evidence: Accessible English full paper; local PDF verified.

records.title: AutoDIR: Automatic All-in-One Image Restoration with Latent Diffusion
records.read_extent: Main text §§1–5, PDF pp. 1–14; Table 2 visually checked. Separate appendix and code not audited.
records.technical: AutoDIR mixes degradation-class probabilities, applies structural-corrected diffusion, and stops on a clean-image class. This supports partial categorical inference/uncertainty and partial stopping, not calibrated operator posteriors or risk-controlled release. Structural comparisons provide partial fidelity evidence; super-resolution metrics show a perception/distortion trade-off.
records.applicability: Partial Q is categorical weighting; partial X is clean-class stopping; neither supplies calibrated reliability.
quality_followups: Compare clean-class stopping against risk-based release; do not treat few-shot JPEG/desnow adaptation as zero-shot testing.

3.evidence: Unknown compound restoration with held-out acquisition tasks.

4.evidence: Operational method/benchmark evaluated in the inspected sections.

5.evidence: Accessible English full paper; local PDF verified.
